body: Chief on W3 candidate d72a8f0: BLOCKED on one HIGH (everything else verifies — independent run embed-core 97/97 JVM+JS, interview 41/41 JVM+JS, fixtures 98/98, compileAll; the reviewer confirmed the closed detection factory, all four P0-1 laundering probes DENIED under a genuine table detector, permissive/v1 denied under a table-only allowlist, empty allowlist denies, config/case-flag/key-rotation flips, pseudo/v2 binding, attempt/v2 detectorIdentity mutation, exact reverse incl. a Deseret name, zero canaries, Unicode word semantics, InterviewSuite diff clean, atlas.scala move lossless). HIGH-1: the allowlist identity does not bind detector BEHAVIOUR — DetectorPolicyIdentity = (id, HMAC(config)) (embed privacy.scala:46-49, 103-114) but PseudonymizationDetector.checked (147-175) is public and takes an arbitrary findSpans closure; probe: rebuild the table's canonical config string (deterministic from the table, :248-253) with the same id, supply a permissive finder returning the caller's map → policyIdentity == the trusted table identity, checked accepts '[P1] met Bob and Smith.' with Bob IN the table, and evaluate under a table-only allowlist AUTHORIZES it — exactly the laundering the allowlist exists to stop, by the party (key + table holder) checked already requires. REQUIRED FIX: identity must determine behaviour — the span finder is a pure function of (id, configuration) INSIDE embed-core (a sealed detector-algorithm ADT, e.g. WholeWordTable parsed from the canonical config; interview supplies only the table data), and the public factory has NO closure parameter; add the impersonation probe as a law (same id + same config + foreign finder is impossible to express; a foreign finder cannot obtain the trusted identity). MEDIUM-2: test-only seams legacyV1ForTest/substituteDetectionsForTest (privacy.scala:362-423) live in main and mint uncertified values under private[embed] (forgeable across jars) — constructor private[embed] with the seams moved to src/test. LOW-3: snapshotKeys is duplicated (embed :191-206, interview :255-269) instead of SensitiveKeySnapshot.capture and the copies accept empty bytes — use capture. LOW-4: state the 'no clean-transcript certification' rule (zero table hits refuses; title/pseudonymizedFrom dropped) in ADR D6. Repost the SHA + 3-platform evidence; same reviewer re-runs probes A–H; I land.
